clarification_topics: What the company sells and who the customers are
Current number of customers (or revenue) and the target for the quarter
What 'improve marketing' means: which channels and which metric
How employee happiness is measured (e.g. eNPS survey) and its current value
Current turnover rate and the target
expected.grader_notes: Deliberately vague sample with no context at all. The correct result is needs_clarification with at most 5 questions, no tasks, and no invented numbers. The questions must cover the baseline/target of at least one numeric KR (O1-KR1 or O2-KR2) and the definition of at least one vague qualitative KR (O1-KR2 or O2-KR1). In addition, at least one question must address O1-KR1 ('Get more customers') or O2-KR1 ('Employees are happier'): the deterministic pre-check does not flag these two because they contain no change keyword, so only the LLM clarify step can catch them. Merging several topics into one question is fine.
